items.title: Mojo is Now Open Source
items.why: This release brings a high-performance programming language designed for AI development to the open-source community, enabling wider adoption and contribution.

items.title: Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs
items.why: This research explores techniques to extract internal thought processes from black-box LLMs, offering insights into their behavior and potential security implications.

items.title: Netflix Shares Insights on In-House LLM Serving
items.why: This article provides critical architectural and operational lessons from Netflix on deploying and managing large language models within their existing production environment.

items.title: Meta Releases Muse Glimmer, an Open-Weight Agentic LLM
items.why: Meta's new 30B parameter Muse Glimmer model, released under a permissive Apache 2.0 license, expands the options for open-source AI development.

items.title: Nvidia Highlights Harness over AI Model for Agent Performance
items.why: Nvidia's research underscores the growing importance of fine-tuning and orchestration ('the harness') in achieving reliable and performant AI agent behavior, rather than solely focusing on the base model's capabilities.
